title: Feature comparison of ack, ag, git-grep, grep and ripgrep
excerpt: There are many greplike tools available to choose from. ripgrep is currently the fastest, which folks seem to focus on, but they have different features. Here's a chart to help you see which tools can do what.
content_html:
